name: hatmaha
description: המטמיעון — ניהול צוות הטמעה. monorepo (client + server + supabase)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
